title: Which guidance applies to API Overview?

question.author: member_007
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of api overview. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current API Reference documentation says: Responses are JSON, and all endpoints are versioned under /v1. The API is available on all plans; Business and Enterprise plans receive higher rate limits on request. The CloudBox REST API provides programmatic access to files, folders, share links, and account metadata. Authentication uses OAuth2 bearer tokens created in the developer console. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
